cases.d: The Secretary adds internal participants with a role.
steps: Open the meeting, tab "Thành phần tham dự".
Click "Thêm người dự họp", search by name or email, select two people, choose Vai trò Thành viên and click "Thêm".
exp: The toast "Thêm thành phần tham dự thành công." appears.
Both people are listed with role Thành viên.
If the meeting is published they receive an invitation.
pre: A Draft or Published meeting; signed in as its Secretary.

cases.d: Invite a guest outside the system by email.
steps: Click "Mời khách ngoài hệ thống (qua email)".
Click "Mời" with empty fields, then enter Tên khách: Khách, email guest@example.test and click "Mời".
exp: Empty: "Nhập tên khách." and "Nhập email hợp lệ.".
After inviting, the guest is listed with the tag Khách and receives an email invitation.
pre: Signed in as the meeting Secretary; SMTP sandbox running.

cases.d: Change roles and hand over the Chair.
steps: Open a participant's menu, choose "Đổi vai trò", pick Thư ký and Lưu.
As the Chair of a Published meeting, choose "Giao Chủ tọa" for a member and confirm.
exp: "Cập nhật vai trò cuộc họp thành công." appears and the role changes.
"Giao vai trò Chủ tọa thành công." appears; the member is Chủ tọa and the former Chair is Thành viên.
pre: A meeting with Chair, Secretary and members.

cases.d: Remove a participant and revoke a guest; the last Secretary is kept.
steps: Choose "Gỡ khỏi cuộc họp" for a member and confirm.
Choose "Thu hồi lời mời" for a guest and confirm.
Try to remove the only Thư ký.
exp: "Gỡ thành phần tham dự thành công." appears; the removed member no longer sees the meeting.
Removing the last Secretary shows "Cuộc họp phải giữ Chủ tọa và Thư ký theo quy định. Hãy phân công người thay thế.".
pre: A meeting with one Secretary, a member and a guest.

steps: Sign in as thanhvien and open the published meeting.
At "Bạn có tham dự cuộc họp này?" click "Tham dự".
Change the answer to "Không tham dự".
exp: "Đã ghi nhận phản hồi lời mời." appears and "Đã xác nhận tham dự" is shown.
The Secretary sees the answer on the roster.
After declining, the meeting no longer shows in thanhvien's calendar.
pre: thanhvien is invited to a Published meeting.

cases.d: Two Secretaries changing the roster at once: the later one is asked to reload.
steps: Open the roster as the Secretary in two tabs.
Without reloading, add another person in tab 2.
exp: Tab 2 shows "Danh sách thành phần đã thay đổi. Vui lòng tải lại và thử lại.".
After reloading, the add succeeds and both people are listed.
pre: A draft meeting; signed in as its Secretary.

cases.d: A deactivated participant is marked on the roster.
steps: Deactivate a participant's account on Người dùng & Quyền.
exp: The person shows the tag "Tài khoản đã khoá".
